name: Bug Tracker
title: Bug Tracker
description: Track software bugs from report to resolution. 4-column workflow with severity labels.

cards.title: Login fails on Safari after OAuth redirect
cards.description: Steps: 1. Open Safari 17.2 2. Click Sign In with Google 3. Observe blank white screen instead of dashboard. Expected: redirect to /dashboard. #bug #critical

cards.title: Memory leak in analytics dashboard
cards.description: Heap grows ~50MB per hour when dashboard tab is left open. Chrome 120, Windows 11. #bug #important

cards.title: Dark mode colors inverted on chart legends
cards.description: Pie chart legend text is white-on-white in dark mode. All chart types affected. #bug #frontend

cards.title: Investigate spike in 502 errors from payment API
cards.description: Started Dec 5 at 14:00 UTC. 300% increase in 502s from Stripe webhook endpoint. @bob #bug #critical

cards.title: Mobile nav menu not closing on outside tap
cards.description: iOS Safari only. Menu stays open when tapping overlay. Regression from v2.3.1. #bug #frontend

cards.title: Patch XSS vulnerability in search input
cards.description: Unescaped user input in /search?q= reflects into page. CVE score pending. @alice #bug #critical #security

cards.title: Fix CSV export encoding for CJK characters
cards.description: Japanese and Chinese text garbled in exported CSV. Need BOM + UTF-8. #bug #backend

cards.title: Update dependencies with known CVEs
cards.description: Patched express (4.18→4.19), ws (8.16→8.17), and vite (5.0→5.1). All CVEs below 7.0. #security

cards.title: Fix email verification link expiring too soon
cards.description: Changed token TTL from 1 hour to 24 hours. Updated tests. due:2026-07-15 #bug
